newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: South Asian port conditions - Lloyds.
newsitem.headline: South Asian port conditions - Lloyds.

text.p: Port conditions from Lloyds Shipping Intelligence Service --

BANGLADESH, Dec 17 - Chittagong - 22 vessels in port of which 4 containers, 7 general cargo, 1 cement, 1 foodgrain, 2 tankers, 1 rapeseed, 1 fertiliser, 1 cement clinker, 4 other vessels. 21 Vessels due by 24/12 of which 8 containers, 6 general cargo, 2 cement, 1 ro/ro, 1 foodgrain, 1 export loader, 1 tanker, 1 other. No berthing delays, port working normally.

INDIA, Dec 17 - Haldia - Due to severe deterioration of Jellinghan Bar inward and outward, drafts for Haldia have been cut by 0.3 metre for the remainder of December with immediate effect. No other information received.

PAKISTAN, Dec 16 - Karachi - 12 Vessels due, up to 24 hours delay expected. 6 Rice vessels loading at berth, 2 containers loading and discharging at berth. 9 Vessels discharging at berth (general cargo, dap, tallow, urea and gas oil. 1 Rice waiting at anchorage to load, 5 vessels waiting at anchorage to discharge (containers, fertiliser, sugar, hsd). 3 Vessels awaiting orders. Port Qasim - Six vessels discharging at berth (fuel oil, sugar, wheat, part cargo and coal). 5 Vessels waiting at anchorage to discharge (steel slabs, sugar, jute and wheat). No vessels waiting at anchorage to load.

SRI LANKA, Dec 17 - Colombo - Vessels due, 1 breakbulk, 3 containers. 2-3 Days delay for conventional vessels. 17 Vessels loading at berth of which 4 essential services, 13 containers. 27 Vessels discharging at berth of which 1 bagged sugar, 4 general cargo, 2 bagged flour, 13 containers, 3 bagged fertiliser, 1 bulk lpg, 1 bagged maize, 2 ro/ro. 2 Container vessels waiting at anchorage to load, 3 waiting at anchorage to discharge of which 2 containers, 1 bagged fertiliser. 2 Vessels bunkering, 8 under repair/drydocks, 1 awaiting orders. Galle - No vessels in port. Trincomalee - Two vessels loading at berth.
